evals.prompt: Implement an evidence-selected Qiskit quantum-kernel classifier.
evals.expected_output: Uses the quantum_kernel profile and current Qiskit kernel APIs.
expectations: Loads only the needed sdk-qiskit.md heading on demand
Reuses QSVC rather than hand-writing a kernel classifier
Serializes and reloads the model in a fresh process

evals.prompt: Build a PennyLane CNN with a trainable quantum head.
evals.expected_output: Routes to QML hybrid_neural instead of a separate Hybrid Skill.
expectations: Uses TorchLayer when compatible instead of a custom autograd bridge
Does not call a generic quantum head QCNN without structural evidence

evals.prompt: Use Cqlib for a local quantum reservoir forecasting model.
evals.expected_output: Uses the framework-owned Cqlib quantum_reservoir adapter.
expectations: Rejects a one-qubit linear placeholder as a reservoir
Does not submit a TianYan job

evals.prompt: Build a local qGAN-style distribution sampler.
evals.expected_output: Uses quantum_generative with the sample operation and distribution diagnostics.
expectations: Rejects threshold sampling as a qGAN implementation
Persists and reloads a loadable bundle

evals.prompt: Build a quantum autoencoder for quantum-state compression.
evals.expected_output: Uses quantum_representation with quantum_data and transform semantics.
expectations: Keeps state preparation and latent/trash wires explicit
Rejects feature centering as a quantum autoencoder

evals.prompt: Build a quantum policy-gradient agent for a tiny local environment.
evals.expected_output: Uses quantum_reinforcement with act semantics and separate evaluation episodes.
expectations: Implements the selected policy-gradient update semantics
Rejects fixed action values as a trained agent

evals.prompt: Build a VQR regression model after planner selects variational_supervised.
evals.expected_output: Uses the selected route without keyword-based reselection.
expectations: Reuses VQR rather than reselecting VQC or writing a custom QNN

evals.prompt: The selected Qiskit route requests kernel_clustering, but the materialized adapter only proves QSVC and QSVR.
evals.expected_output: Reports the selected variant as unavailable without substitution.
expectations: Does not run QSVC and call it clustering
Does not hand-write an unverified clustering adapter
